owner: Inner Cosmos Psychology Capability Working Group

title.zh-CN: 认出一个反复出现的念头

description.zh-CN: 把一个反复出现的念头放回它的情境里，试着写出第二种读法，不评判对错。
description.en-SG: Place one recurring thought back in its context and try writing a second reading, without judging it right or wrong.

evidence: Beck 1976, Cognitive Therapy and the Emotional Disorders

limitations.zh-CN: 这是反思练习，不提供心理治疗，也不识别或纠正『认知歪曲』；不适合急性痛苦时使用，反复念头涉及自伤请立即使用安全资源。证据出处与文案待心理专家复核（CP-60A 双专家门禁）。
limitations.en-SG: This is a reflection exercise: it is not psychotherapy and does not detect or correct "cognitive distortions". It is not for acute distress; if a recurring thought involves self-harm, use the safety resources immediately. Evidence citations and wording await psychology expert review (CP-60A dual-expert gate).
